paper.title: The novel SMAC mimetic birinapant exhibits potent activity against human melanoma cells
paper.authors: Krepler C, Chunduru SK, Halloran MB, He X, Xiao M, Vultur A, Villanueva J, Mitsuuchi Y, Neiman EM, Benetatos C, Nathanson KL, Amaravadi RK, Pehamberger H, McKinlay M, Herlyn M

contexts.genetic_background: BRAF V600E, NRAS mutations, KIT, CTNNB1/β-catenin, triple wild-type
contexts.notes: Representative of 5 major genetic subgroups of cutaneous melanoma; all cell lines resistant to TNF-α as single agent; endogenous TNF-α present in all supernatants
Three-dimensional model; response patterns closely mirrored monolayer culture; expected to predict in vivo efficacy more accurately
451Lu: in vitro combination-sensitive, excellent in vivo response; 1205Lu: in vitro resistant, partial in vivo response showing complexity of tissue microenvironment

assays.method: MTS proliferation assay (CellTiter 96 AQueous Non-Radioactive Cell Proliferation Assay)
assays.readout: IC50 (concentration causing 50% reduction in viable cell count); % cell viability relative to control

assays.method: Propidium iodide staining + flow cytometry; cells fixed in 70% ethanol
assays.readout: Relative number of cells in sub-G1 fraction (indicative of apoptosis/DNA fragmentation)

assays.method: Annexin V allophycocyanin conjugate + flow cytometry
assays.readout: Relative number of Annexin V positive cells (early/late apoptosis marker)

assays.method: Western blot analysis; SDS-PAGE; anti-cIAP1 (AF8181, R&D), anti-cIAP2 (AF8171, R&D); quantified by Odyssey scanning
assays.readout: Relative protein levels; band intensity normalized to GAPDH loading control
assays.incubation_time: 24 hours (for cell culture); post-dose for xenograft

assays.method: Western blot analysis; anti-PARP (7150, Santa Cruz); cleaved (85 kDa) vs full-length PARP
assays.readout: Presence of cleaved PARP band (indicator of caspase-3/7 activation and apoptosis)

assays.method: Western blot analysis; anti-NF-κB p65 (3031, Cell Signaling), anti-NFKB2 p100-p52 (4882, Cell Signaling)
assays.readout: p65 and p100/p52 protein levels normalized to GAPDH

assays.method: Western blot analysis; anti-RIP1 (51-6559GR, BD Biosciences); quantified by Odyssey scanning
assays.readout: Relative protein levels; normalized to GAPDH

assays.method: Real-time RT-PCR (TaqMan, Life Technologies); cDNA synthesis from total RNA; assay ID Hs00169407_m1; normalized to GUSB housekeeping gene
assays.readout: Relative quantity of RIPK1 to GUSB (comparative Ct method)

assays.method: Alamar Blue (Invitrogen) metabolic assay on collagen-embedded spheroids in 96-well format; 72h incubation with compounds
assays.readout: Fluorescence intensity (measure of metabolic activity/viable cells)

assays.method: Live/Dead viability assay kit (calcein AM green + ethidium homodimer-1 red); confocal microscopy (Leica TCS SP2) imaging
assays.readout: Percentage of live (green) vs dead (red) cells per spheroid

assays.method: Subcutaneous xenograft; tumor volume measured by caliper (V = length × width² / 2); measured twice weekly
assays.readout: Fold change in tumor volume compared to first day of dosing

assays.method: Paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tumor sections (5 µm); immunohistochemistry with activated caspase-3 mAb (5A1E, Cell Signaling); anti-counterstain with Harris' hematoxylin
BD OptEIA Human TNFa ELISA Kit II; supernatants collected from 72h culture at 70% confluence; 200 µL tested in triplicate
assays.readout: TNF-α concentration in cell culture supernatant

conditions.notes: MTS assay incubation; cell viability assessed
Recombinant human TNF-α from Invitrogen; all cell lines resistant to TNF-α as single agent
Combined treatment; varying doses of birinapant with fixed TNF-α concentration

conditions.dose: 1 µM birinapant + 1 ng/mL TNF-α ± Z-VAD-FMK (pan-caspase inhibitor)
conditions.notes: Mechanism study: pan-caspase inhibitor completely restores proliferation when added to combination

conditions.dose: 1 µM birinapant + 1 ng/mL TNF-α ± Necrostatin-1 (RIP1 kinase inhibitor)
conditions.notes: Mechanism study: RIP1 kinase inhibition completely reverses combination effect

conditions.dose: 1 µM birinapant ± increasing doses of TNF-α blocking antibody
conditions.notes: Dose-dependent TNF-α neutralization completely abrogates birinapant effect in WM9
Collagen-embedded 3D spheroid model; Live/Dead staining and Alamar Blue viability
NUDE mice bearing 451Lu or 1205Lu xenografts; dosing started after palpable tumor formation; vehicle: 12.5% Captisol in distilled water

observations.notes: Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: cleaved PARP band clearly visible in WM9 birinapant-alone lane, absent in untreated/TNF-a-alone lanes. PARP cleavage detected in WM9 with birinapant alone (24h); indicative of caspase-3/7 activation

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: cleaved PARP band visible only in 451Lu birinapant+TNF-a combination lane. PARP cleavage detected only with combination (24h); not present with single agents
Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: cleaved PARP band visible only in WM1366 combination lane. PARP cleavage detected with combination only (24h)

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: no cleaved PARP band detectable in 1205Lu even in combination lane, consistent with resistant phenotype. No PARP cleavage detected even with combination (24h); apoptosis pathway blocked downstream

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: NF-kB p65 band intensity visibly reduced in WM9 birinapant-treated lanes relative to untreated. Decrease in NF-κB p65 protein levels observed in WM9 only; not observed in combination-sensitive or resistant lines

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 2B immunoblot: RIP1 band intensity reduced in combination-treated lanes for combination-sensitive lines. RIP1 protein depleted in 3/4 combination-sensitive lines when birinapant and TNF-α combined (24h)

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 4A confocal Live(green)/Dead(red) images: 451Lu combination-treated spheroid shows visibly increased red (dead) signal vs green-dominant control/single-agent spheroids. Confocal microscopy showed marked reduction in live cells (green) and increase in dead cells (red) with combination

Verified by direct inspection of Figure 5C IHC images: visibly increased brown/purple staining in 24h-post-birinapant tumor sections vs vehicle for both 451Lu and 1205Lu, though 1205Lu increase is more modest. Modest increase in apoptotic cells at 24h post-treatment in both models; paraffin-embedded section IHC staining
